messages:
alex: Heads-up — seeing recurring OOMs on prod small models around ~9k tokens. Symptoms look like allocator growth rather than KV-cache retention. Can folks run a quick defrag/heap profile and drop results here?

maria: Which allocator are we attributing this to? jemalloc on dedicated pools, right?

alex: Yes, jemalloc (system build 5.2). tcache disabled in our runtime. Sampling shows arena counts creeping up over long runs. Suspect fragmentation from transient large buffers in attention kernels.

jyoti: I can run pprof/jeprof on dedicated-staging. What exact command + env did you use to repro?

alex: Repro command I used locally:```
LD_PRELOAD=/usr/lib/x86_64-linux-gnu/libjemalloc.so \nMALLOC_CONF=\"oversize_threshold:1,narenas:1,dirty_decay_ms:30000,muzzy_decay_ms:30000\" \n./run_bench --model r-1.2 --max-tokens 8000 --batch 4
```
(we bind to 8k tokens seq, batch 4 to push peak memory)

chris: FYI I opened a small micro-optimizing PR that shortens the lifetime of an intermediate buffer in attention (PR #4728). Microbench showed ~10-15% peak reduction on CPU tests.

maria: I'll queue a perf job on staging (dedicated-staging) to run the exact command with heap profiling enabled. ETA ~30m.

infra-bot: Deploy triggered: perf/oom/1765001234-alloc-sweep — started by maria

jyoti: Two quick experiment ideas: 1) try jemalloc background_thread:true and lower decay ms to force faster purge; 2) run with jemalloc stats enabled and capture top arena sizes via jeprof. Both might be helpful.

alex: Good ideas. Also try enabling background_thread + set narenas:1 to avoid per-thread arena blowup for the test. If fragmentation persists we should test mimalloc build as a comparison.

maria: First heap profile posted: ```total_allocated: 1.9GB; active: 1.2GB; mapped: 2.3GB. Top frames by allocs: attention.cpp:324, kv_cache.cpp:112, tokenizer.cpp:58``` Uploaded to staging artifacts: <https://artifacts.internal/reports/1765001234/heap1>

jyoti: attention.cpp:324 is exactly the temp per-head buffer. If PR #4728 lands we should see that disappear. Running with PR + jemalloc tweaks now.

chris: If staging shows improvement can we canary the change on dedicated (1% traffic) and monitor OOMs/latency? Prefer to avoid big rollout without perf guardrails.

alex: Agreed. Also can someone add an alloc-peak benchmark to eng-runtime/bench/alloc_peak_test that runs the 8k sequence scenario nightly so regressions catch early?

maria: I'll add the bench and the perf pipeline hook. Will post results here when finished.

alex: Thanks. One more ask — when you upload jeprof outputs, include the top-5 malloc call sites and arena stats. That helps narrow fragmentation vs true leaks.

maria: Noted. Will include.

alex: Thanks team :thumbsup:
